description: Stirred the gum and asked whether he played.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Boiled the Monday ink, measured the loaf by eye, and took threepence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Came in for bread, and did not weigh the loaf.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Ate, kept Sunday's bill undivided, and named the afternoon's part.
name: William Shakespeare
